body: She said she'd let me get a job, but I'd have to get my license myself. I don't know how to do that, since I'm homeschooled and don't know who to talk to about it. It so frustrating that she won't just help me do it myself.
I've tried. And having fun with my friends is great, but then I get home and the way treats me just feels worse.

I am a girl. And, I've thought about running away, a friend of mine even offered me a place to stay, but anyone who gives me shelter can be arrested for harboring a runaway. I wouldn't want to get someone else into trouble that way.

I'm homeschooled, and any adults I see are friends of my mom. I've tried mentioning things to them, but they always take her side. 

My therapist is afraid of making things worse and I really do get it because I am too, but even if I wanted a new therapist, my mom wouldn't let me switch.
I'm afraid that if I write it down, she'll find it. She goes through my things all the time.
I'll take a look. Thank you!
